# Troll Chest

## What is it?
Troll Chest is a mod that adds a new chest, but when opened, spawns a exploding creeper behind the player.

## How to craft?
  To craft, place a regular chest in the center of the 3x3 crafting board and surround it with gunpowder. You can also refer to the featured gallery image.
